trigger.name: Friday 3 PM schedule
trigger.fn: Starts one run every Friday at 3:00 PM America/New_York, or on demand from chat.
inputs: Workbook path under WORKFORCE_WINDOWS_ROOT. Default trackers\project-tracker.xlsx
YYYY-MM-DD. Default the Friday of the run
Address for the review draft. No default; asked once if missing
Folder under the root. Default reports
tests: Scheduled run with all inputs set
exactly 1 workforce task is created and its first handoff goes to Tracker Reader
reply contains STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT and names manager_email
Run with tracker_path that does not exist
reply contains FAILED and the exact path; no .docx is created

master.name: Weekly Status Coordinator
master.fn: Turns the task tracker into a reviewed weekly status report and a review-only email draft.
master.prompt:
You are the Weekly Status Coordinator. You never write report content yourself.
Inputs: tracker_path, week_ending, manager_email, reports_folder.
If tracker_path or manager_email is missing, reply STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT and name each missing field. Ask once.
Route in this order:
1. Tracker Reader: send tracker_path. Receive rows and the workstream rollup.
2. Status Analyst: send the rows and rollup. Receive progress, risks, and RAG status per workstream.
3. Report Writer: send the analysis and week_ending. Receive the report text and the saved .docx path.
4. Report Reviewer: send the report text and the analysis. Receive PASS or REVISE with numbered issues.
   If REVISE, send the issues back to Report Writer. Maximum 2 rounds. After 2 REVISE rounds, stop with STATUS: UNRESOLVED.
5. Delivery Agent: send the .docx path, the one-paragraph summary, and manager_email. Receive the draft entry_id.
If any agent returns FAILED or an error, stop, report FAILED with the agent name and its error, and save nothing further.
The Delivery Agent's draft waits for human approval; nothing is ever sent.
Final reply: one line per step with its status, the link to the saved .docx, and the Outlook draft entry_id.
handoffs: rows, rollup by workstream, row count
tests: Tracker with 3 workstreams and 24 tasks, manager_email set
every handoff runs once; exactly 1 .docx in reports; exactly 1 Outlook draft; 0 emails sent
Report Writer output missing the Risks section
Reviewer returns REVISE once, the second draft passes, round count = 2
tracker_path points to a missing file
reply contains FAILED and Tracker Reader; 0 .docx files and 0 drafts created

reader.name: Tracker Reader
reader.fn: Reads the task tracker workbook and returns clean rows plus counts by workstream.
reader.model_reason: Extraction and counting only; no judgement.
tools: Use after reading, on the rows it returned
reader.prompt:
You are Tracker Reader. Input: tracker_path.
Steps: 1. Call Read Task Tracker with tracker_path. 2. Call Workstream Rollup on the rows.
Output JSON: { "rows": [...], "rollup": {...}, "row_count": n }.
If the file is missing or has no header row, return FAILED with the path. Never invent a row or a value.
tests: row_count = 24 and rollup has exactly 3 keys
Tracker path that does not exist
returns FAILED and the exact path
Tracker with a blank Owner cell
that row keeps owner = null; nothing is filled in

analyst.name: Status Analyst
analyst.fn: Judges progress, risks, and RAG status per workstream from the rows and the RAG rules.
analyst.model_reason: Judgement over many rows with written rationale.
tools: Use first to load the RAG rules and section template
analyst.prompt:
You are Status Analyst. Input: rows and rollup.
Steps: 1. Call Report Template Lookup with query "RAG rules". 2. For each workstream apply only those rules.
Output, per workstream: name, done/total, overdue count, RAG (Red, Amber, Green) with the rule that set it, top 3 risks each citing task IDs.
Use only facts from the rows. If a workstream has no tasks, say "No tasks found" instead of guessing.
tests: RAG = Red and the cited rule names overdue critical tasks
that workstream text contains exactly "No tasks found"
Rows where every task is done
every RAG = Green and risks list is empty

drafter.name: Report Writer
drafter.fn: Writes the weekly status report and saves it as a Word document; revises from reviewer issues.
drafter.model_reason: Drafting quality prose for a manager audience.
tools: Use first to load the section template
Use last, once per round, to save the .docx
drafter.prompt:
You are Report Writer. Input: analysis, week_ending, reports_folder, and on revision the reviewer's issues.
Steps: 1. Call Report Template Lookup with query "status report sections". 2. Write the report in this order: Summary (one paragraph), Workstream status table, Risks and mitigations, Next week, Decisions needed. 3. Call Write Report Document with path <reports_folder>\Weekly-Status_<week_ending>.docx.
Output: report text and the saved path. On revision, fix every numbered issue and list each under "Revision notes".
Never invent a number, owner, or date that is not in the analysis.
tests: report has the 5 sections in order and the table has exactly 3 rows
exactly 2 revision notes, one per issue
returns STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT naming week_ending; no .docx saved

reviewer.name: Report Reviewer
reviewer.fn: Checks the report against the analysis and the template. Returns PASS or REVISE.
reviewer.model_reason: Careful comparison of numbers and claims.
tools: Use to confirm the required sections
reviewer.prompt:
You are Report Reviewer. Input: report text and analysis.
Match every number, RAG value, and task ID in the report to the analysis. Call Report Template Lookup to confirm all 5 template sections exist in order.
Output: Verdict: PASS or REVISE, then numbered issues (location, problem, exact fix).
PASS only with zero number mismatches and zero missing sections. Never add content yourself.
tests: Report with one wrong done/total count
verdict = REVISE and the issue names that workstream

delivery.name: Delivery Agent
delivery.fn: Creates the review-only Outlook draft to the manager. Never sends.
delivery.approval: Create Review Email Draft is always-ask
delivery.prompt:
You are Delivery Agent. Input: docx path, summary, manager_email.
Call Create Review Email Draft with subject "Weekly status: week ending <date>", the summary as body, and the docx path as a line in the body.
Output: entry_id and subject. Never call any send tool. If manager_email is missing, return STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT.
tests: returns FAILED with that error code

t_readtracker.name: Read Task Tracker
t_readtracker.fn: Reads the tracker worksheet as rows (Excel COM).
t_readtracker.searched: list_tools and search_public_tools had no Excel reader; the server's com family has excel_read_range.
inputs: Workbook path under the workspace root
tests: values has 25 rows including the header

t_rollup.name: Workstream Rollup
t_rollup.fn: Turns header + rows into objects and counts done, open, and overdue per workstream.
t_rollup.searched: No existing rollup tool; a code step is deterministic.
inputs: Rows from Read Task Tracker, header first
steps: code: const [h,...r]=params.values; const rows=r.map(x=>Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,i)=>[k,x[i]??null]))); const by={}; for(const t of rows){const w=t.Workstream||'(none)'; const b=(by[w]??={total:0,done:0,overdue:0}); b.total++; if(String(t.Status).toLowerCase()==='done') b.done++; else if(t.Due && String(t.Due)<params.as_of) b.overdue++;} return {rows, rollup:by, row_count: rows.length};
t_rollup.schema: { rows: array, rollup: object, row_count: number }
tests: 3 rows: 2 in A (1 done), 1 in B overdue

t_template.name: Report Template Lookup
t_template.fn: Searches the RAG rules and report template knowledge table.
t_template.searched: No existing lookup; knowledge search step.
inputs: What to look up, e.g. RAG rules
steps: store: status_templates · base: rag-rules · query: {{params.query}} · top_k: 3 · filters: status == active
t_template.schema: { results: array<{ score, row }> , matched: boolean }

t_writedoc.name: Write Report Document
t_writedoc.fn: Saves the report text as a .docx (Word COM). Safe to retry with overwrite.
t_writedoc.searched: The server's com family has word_create_document.
inputs: Path under the root, e.g. reports\Weekly-Status_2026-11-20.docx
tests: created = true and path ends with qa.docx

t_draftemail.name: Create Review Email Draft
t_draftemail.fn: Saves an unsent Outlook draft (classic Outlook COM).
t_draftemail.searched: The server's com family has outlook_create_draft; outlook_send is never attached.

prereqs: Windows + desktop Word + Excel + classic Outlook
Windows Task Scheduler or a Claude Code scheduled task
unverified: Outlook draft attachments: outlook_create_draft has no attachment parameter, so the .docx path goes in the body
